operations.name: Saw Cut Stock
operations.setup_note: Cut individual round-bar blanks to the confirmed finished length plus facing allowance. The finished length is not given in the routing view.

operations.name: CNC Lathe – Roughing
operations.setup_note: Chuck the saw-cut solid bar blank, face one end to establish an axial reference, then rough the OD before rough boring for chucking rigidity. Use steady support if the confirmed length requires it.

operations.name: CNC Lathe – Finish Bore
operations.setup_note: Hold on the rough-turned OD and finish the bore to size before finishing the OD, to reduce the risk of bore pressure distorting the tube wall.

operations.name: CNC Lathe – Finish OD and First-End Edges
operations.setup_note: Locate on the finished bore with an expanding mandrel and finish the OD. Machine the accessible end-edge details after the adjacent cylindrical surfaces are finished.

operations.name: CNC Lathe – Reverse and Finish Second End
operations.setup_note: Reverse the part and hold it without damaging the finished surfaces. Face the second end to the confirmed overall length, then machine its chamfer and specified edge radius.

operations.name: Deburr
operations.setup_note: Deburr and clean the finished part, preserving the specified chamfers and radii.

operations.name: Final Inspection
operations.setup_note: Inspect the finished OD and ID, bore circularity, end-edge details, and overall length against the drawing and applicable process specification.

clarifications.question: Should the blank be supplied as mechanical tubing, or should the part be machined from solid round bar?
clarifications.suggested_default: Proceed from hot-rolled round bar because no tube blank or mechanical-tubing grade is specified.

clarifications.question: What is the finished overall length of the tube?
What additional manufacturing or inspection requirements apply under PS-135.6?
clarifications.suggested_default: Follow the drawing requirements and standard shop practice until the specification is provided.

assumptions.text: Because the blank type is unstated and no mechanical-tubing grade or tube stock dimensions are given, the provisional stock choice is hot-rolled round bar.
Stock length is left unspecified because the finished overall length is absent; saw-cut length and final facing must be set after confirmation.
Grooving and threading steps from the turning template are omitted because no groove or thread features are present in the routing view.
Part-off is omitted because the route uses individually saw-cut blanks rather than bar-fed machining.
Center drilling is not included in the provisional route; if the confirmed length requires additional support, select an appropriate support method for the hollowing sequence.
